> 🔒 **Important:** Please **do not** use this public form for unpatched security vulnerabilities.
> Instead, follow the private disclosure process in [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md):
>
> 1. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Qaxlabs/AutoDMX/security/advisories/new) feature, or
> 2. Contact a maintainer via the GitHub profile linked in the README.
>
> This template is here for completeness and to guide you to the right channel.

If you've already disclosed the issue privately and want to track the public side of the fix here, summarize the affected component and reference the GitHub Security Advisory number.
